programmes.d: The Serpent Society use a portal through space and time and unravel history.

programmes.t: The Librarian: Quest for the Spear
programmes.d: The librarian sets out across the globe to ensure the safe return of a stolen artifact.
Jenkins discovers there's something wrong with the Library.
Prospero summons up other Fictionals in order to retrieve the parts of his Staff from a museum.
The Librarians take on a shape-shifting god who grows in strength any time a lie is told.
Students start disappearing at Wexler College.
Flynn is kidnapped by a mysterious stranger with amnesia.
An old friend of Baird's is running for Mayor of a small New Hampshire town.
The team tracks the perpetually young Dorian Gray.
The Clipping Book sends the team to a high-tech research facility.
The team has scattered, all living the ideal versions of their lives.
The Librarians discover that Prospero's renewed magic is wreaking havoc.

programmes.t: The Librarian: Return to King Solomon's Mines
programmes.d: Flynn’s latest adventure finds him in search of the fabled King Solomon’s mines.
The Egyptian God of Chaos inhabits a human body and mannequins come to life.
Flynn leads his fellow Librarians on a mission to rescue kidnapped Charlene.
A routine artifact retrieval is anything but when the artifact grafts itself to Cassandra.
Baird tries to cheat fate and stop the deadly prophecy from coming true.
The Librarians investigate a mysterious travelling carnival.
The team must find the Eye of Ra in the Bermuda Triangle.
The obnoxious Cindy Kroger has suddenly become super-popular thanks to a magical love potion.
People spontaneously combusting leads the Librarians to a holistic spa run by vampires.
The Monkey King's sacred homeland of Shangri-La is taken over.
The Librarians' two-front battle comes to a head.
